resources.string: Lets OwnTV put the TV into standby: from a shortcut with the standby action, or after the screensaver has run for a while. With HDMI-CEC the TV switches off too. OwnTV does not read the screen or anything you do.

Lets OwnTV see which app is open for recent apps, and give remote buttons another job, also inside other apps. Only bound buttons are acted on, except while detecting buttons in settings. Detected button codes and app last-use times are saved on this TV; key presses are not recorded or sent.
